a-list.d: a list of names of specially favored people

a-team.d: a group of elite soldiers or a leadership group of advisors or workers in an organization

a.d: any of several fat-soluble vitamins essential for normal vision; prevents night blindness or inflammation or dryness of the eyes

a-horizon.d: the top layer of a soil profile; usually contains humus

a-bomb.d: a nuclear weapon in which enormous energy is released by nuclear fission (splitting the nuclei of a heavy element like uranium 235 or plutonium 239)

a-line.d: women's clothing that has a fitted top and a flared skirt that is widest at the hemline

a few.d: more than one but indefinitely small in number

a hundred times.d: by a factor of one hundred

a priori.d: involving deductive reasoning from a general principle to a necessary effect; not supported by fact

a lot.d: to a very great degree or extent

a good deal.d: to a very great degree or extent

a fortiori.d: with greater reason; for a still stronger, more certain reason

a million times.d: by a factor of a million

a la carte.d: (of a restaurant meal) having unlimited choices with a separate price for each item

a couple of.d: more than one but indefinitely small in number

a posteriori.d: involving reasoning from facts or particulars to general principles or from effects to causes

a la mode.d: in the current fashion or style

a great deal.d: to a very great degree or extent
